perche: ENTRY Z-C21.3 (the probe verdicts), finding L9-4 (= C5-4). The catalogue says taglia_membri trims the bars where they meet OR EXTENDS them until they touch. Up to library 0.141.0 it passed Options = 8 (the weld gap bit only) to InsertWeldmentTrimFeature2, and the only bench case was a cut. The Z-C21.3 probe of 28/9/2026 (typed Body2[] arrays, TUBO STRUTTURALE QUADRO 80X80X5, end condition Trim) measured: with a bar stopping 20 mm short of the other, Options 8 and 10 return a feature that is NOT in the tree and change nothing, 9 and 11 extend the bar to the face; with a bar entering the other, 8 and 11 cut the same -58798.23 mm3 while 15 (with the coped cut bit 4) cuts -57636.82. The guide gives the bits (swWeldmentTrimExtendOptionType_e: AllowTrimmedExtensionTrim 1, AllowTrimmingExtensionTrim 2, CopedCut 4, WeldGap 8). The library now passes 1 | 2 | 8 = 11.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: Step 3 asks to trim a bar that does not reach the other one: it must be EXTENDED to the other's face. On library 0.141.0 SOLIDWORKS answers with a phantom feature, not in the tree, and the step is refused: red. The plain cut with the new Options is il_taglio_accorcia_la_barra, unchanged (the probe: 8 and 11 give the same cut).
